name: Maine
description: Follow Maine, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Fact-Checking 3 Competitive Senate Races in Maine, Michigan and Ohio
changes.summary: Republican attacks have focused on terrorism and illegal immigration, while Democrats have sought to capitalize on the unpopularity of President Trump’s cuts to Medicaid.

changes.title: Women in Maine may choose the victor in this year's Senate race
changes.summary: The race between Susan Collins and Troy Jackson is one of the nation's most high-profile Senate contests this year -- and may ultimately be decided by an especially powerful voting bloc: Maine women.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: President Donald Trump’s most vocal opponents on the right were sowing the seeds for a future third-party political organization during a weekend get-together aimed at undercutting the Republican establishment. The meeting at Tucker Carlson’s compound in Maine with Rep. Thomas Massie, former Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene.

changes.title: One Maine community's fight to save a birthing center
changes.summary: In mid-coast Maine a grassroots coalition is fighting to prevent the proposed closure of Miles Hospital's labor and delivery center.

changes.title: How a community rallied around a little girl and her love for roosters
changes.summary: CBS News contributor David Begnaud shows how the small town of Ogunquit, Maine, rallied around a 6-year-old girl when local code enforcement officials told the girl's family to take a flock of tin roosters off their property.

changes.title: Bernie Sanders on if he regrets Platner endorsement: ‘Easier to be a Monday morning quarterback’
changes.summary: In an exclusive interview with Meet the Press, Sen. Bernie Sanders (I-Vt.) shares his thoughts on the Maine Senate race after Sen. John Fetterman (D-Pa.) criticized Sanders for having “no regrets” over endorsing Graham Platner.

changes.title: After Democratic Shake-Up, Susan Collins Holds Enormous Cash Edge in Maine
changes.summary: Republicans are pouring huge sums behind the Maine senator through a web of billionaire-funded super PACs. Troy Jackson, picked as the new Democratic nominee, has a lot of catching up to do.

changes.title: Maine Democrats pick Troy Jackson to replace Platner on Senate ballot
changes.summary: Maine Democrats gathered Saturday to select former state Senate President Troy Jackson as the Senate nominee to replace Graham Platner on the ballot.

changes.title: Democrats in Maine formally nominate Troy Jackson as their new candidate for U.S. Senate
changes.summary: Democrats are hoping to move past Graham Platner's scandal-plagued campaign as they look to unseat Susan Collins. In Jackson, they chose a nominee with a similar economic populist message as Platner. (Image credit: Ashley L. Conti for NPR).

changes.title: Troy Jackson secures Democratic nomination for Maine Senate seat after chaotic primary race
